purpose: Reviewed fund identities for statement fund names that print no fund code.
CIBC Investor's Edge / Imperial Service statements print only the fund
name and class label, so these identities were researched outside the
statements and recorded here for review. Humans and AI agents both apply
this file through: ledger ingest resolve-fund-lookup --file data/fund_lookups.json
Re-run ingest afterwards so the staged resolver picks the identities up.
research_source: z.ai web search (CIBC official fund pages, Fund Library FundServ codes, CANNEX fund-symbol table, Globe & Mail fundata, YCharts)
symbol_scheme_note: resolved_symbol values are FundServ (dealer-network) codes as published by
CIBC on its fund pages; each entry also records the CANNEX/fundata fund
symbol (CIBxxx) that cross-checks the same fund/class. A FundServ code is
a broker identifier, not a Yahoo/provider ticker.
